'''Kadrillians''' were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[terrapin]]s who colonized [[Kadril]] in [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]]. They were the only inhabitants of Kadril to survive the [[Stenax Massacres]].

==Physiology==
Kadrillians were smaller than [[Human/Legends|humans]] and had a greenish skin. They evolved from earth-like chameleons.<ref name="PoK">"[[Planet of Kadril]]"</ref> Kadrillians were able to use [[I.Q. Whirl]]<nowiki/>s to read the intelligence of other Kadrillians.

==Society==
[[File:Kadrillians.png|thumb|left|250px|A group of Kadrillians]]
It was unknown where the Kadrillians evolved, but in the decade before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] they colonized the world of Kadril. The Kadrillians were peaceful and dedicated themselves to the manufacturing of all kinds of crystals used for medicine and communication. On this world, the group divided into two groups, one sought safety from inside cities and were quite shy. Another group, the [[Nociv]], felt that the Kadrillians deviated too much from their original counterparts and were more primitive in nature. However, both groups were peaceful.<ref name="PoK" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Kadril was visited by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] as well as by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Darth Vader tried to make a filter for a chemical weapon called [[Pacifog]] with the [[Kunda stone|Kunda stones]] on Kadril. Eventually, the heroes prevented this by seeking help from the Nociv.

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Kadril was destroyed during the [[Stenax Massacres]]. However, the Kadrillians survived the bombing of their world.
